zh-Hans: 请重点体验手记内 Office 助手读取当前手写内容、写入空白单元格并求和保存，以及助手侧栏开启时的普通／画笔双指缩放。请检查落笔过程中线段是否持续显示、连续书写和保存重开后的笔迹，并反馈真实 Apple Pencil 的跟手、压感及误触表现。
en-US: Try reading handwritten content with the Office assistant in Notes, filling blank cells, calculating totals and saving. Check two-finger zoom with drawing on or off while the assistant sidebar is open, live stroke visibility, continuous writing, and ink after save/reopen. Please report physical Apple Pencil responsiveness, pressure and palm rejection.
